why: Generative UI is safe only if one validator sits between model output and render. defineBlock, defineCatalog and Block are that trust boundary; expectCatalog gives every consumer catalog one contract test.
what: defineBlock, defineCatalog, validate, Block, expectCatalog in ./testing, P5, P7. Seeds are app-owned (v3-ai-i9). Owned paths are under packages/basalt-ui/.
must_not_touch: package.json and bun.lock (v3-deps-w2 / v3-deps-ai added your pins)
contract: Frozen: src/ai/contract.ts (v3-rel-7-contracts, an ancestor), docs/v3/concepts/ai-mdx.md decisions 7, 8, row 11, section 4 and P5, P7. props is a Standard Schema (@standard-schema/spec). prompt(), jsonSchema(), mdxComponents, fences are deferred: do not build them. Needs `./testing` (v3-qa-i3), StatCard and src/core/phase (v3-exemplar-statcard), DataPanel (v3-cards-1-statgroup): all ancestors. Block text goes through the url policy in src/core (v3-ai-i1). A needed contract change: signal, take the reversible default. src/ai imports src/content only; `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` are test devDependencies, never imported in src.
change: defineBlock({name, description, props, limits?, sample, render, reserve?}), defineCatalog(blocks). validate(x) rejects oversize (default 32 KiB, depth 6) and walks the parsed value sending every href, src, url, link key at any depth through the url policy; errors are model-readable and end in advice. Block({spec, phase, onEvent}) = validate + per-block error boundary + the composite's phase skeleton + quiet 'could not be displayed' (key ai.blockUnavailable, added by this Issue to src/core/messages/ai.ts). expectCatalog(CatalogLike): samples validate and render in every phase; oversize and hostile-URL props fuzzed from each sample. Rule: type-level (`sample` required) plus expectCatalog, the shipped contract test. Skill snippet: JSDoc @example on defineBlock and defineCatalog.
commits: Two commits in one PR: packages/basalt-ui/** apart from everything else (isolated-basalt-ui hook); `make sync-self` output its own non-package commit; conventional, empty scope, no feat! or BREAKING CHANGE, no attribution; rebase-merge.
